map.给市场物料做品牌二维码：加 Logo 或换成品牌色，同时保持足够对比度与纠错等级: Make branded QR codes for marketing materials: add a logo or apply brand colors while keeping enough contrast and error-correction, avoiding scan failures.
map.中心嵌 Logo、改前景色，仍保证容错(建议 25–30%)。: Embed a centered logo and change the foreground color while keeping error correction (recommend 25–30%).
map.加 Logo 有什么讲究？: What to watch when adding a logo?
map.核心是「别吃掉太多纠错余量」：建议把 Logo 面积控制在二维码总面积的 10%: The core is "don't eat too much correction margin": keep the logo under 10% of the QR area, center it, and raise correction to H (recovers ~30% of codewords). Also keep high contrast with a dark foreground on a light background—a light logo on white is the easiest to fail. After changes, always verify by scanning with several phones.
